content:
**Ricochet** is a Luck-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increases Deflect chance based on Luck. Stacks additively with other deflect chance bonuses.

| ![Ricochet Bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/d/d1/Ricochet_Bonus.png) | | 
| | Luck | Deflect | 
| | 1 | +4% | 
| | 15 | +14% | 
| | 30 | +20% | 
| | 60 | +30% | 
| | 100 | +35% | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain a chance to Deflect ranged attacks based on LCK. | 0031E520 | 

Update 56 decreased ranks from 3 to 1 and changed the effect. Previously it provided 6%/12%/18% chance to deflect back 25% of enemies' ranged attack, the attack received bonus from weapon legendary effects.
